title: Configurational Taxonomy of Planetary Bodies: A Fuzzy-Set QCA of Orbital Hierarchy, Dynamical Dominance, Composition, and Evolution
domain: planetary science / comparative methods / set-theoretic analysis / taxonomy
summary: A falsification-first configurational taxonomy of Solar System bodies. The frozen 50-body frame now has a 50-row raw physical matrix, authoritative JPL core fields for 34 cases, an auditable JPL SBDB route for the remaining 16 small bodies, and source-faithful Margot/Soter dynamics code while definitional and non-definitional models remain separated.

aris.provenance: ARIS4C user-requested project registered 2026-09-24. Initial framing separates definitional classification from causal inference and treats Mars as a positive control. Pilot-0 froze the 50-body stratified frame, raw-variable dictionary, compact 4–6-condition model ladder, anti-circularity benchmark, and deterministic frame validator before numerical QCA solutions were inspected. Physical-core v0.1 then materialized all 50 rows, ingested JPL values for 8 planets, 5 dwarf planets and 21 satellites, reserved 16 small-body rows for an auditable SBDB snapshot, and implemented Margot 2015 / Soter 2006 dynamical metrics from source equations.
